title: Administrative Office Assistant II
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

outcomes: Demonstrate the ability to use entry-level to intermediate Microsoft Office software suite and Google Workspace application skills in a business environment.

Identify, describe, and apply ethical best practices and responsible use guidelines of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) powered applications, such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or Google Gemini, to complete administrative professional tasks, including document creation, communication, and scheduling.

Develop foundational office management competencies by integrating administrative, accounting, and office software tools into simulated administrative professional scenarios and business documents. Upon completion, students will be able to apply office management principles, create, organize, and analyze data using Microsoft Excel, and perform essential administrative professional tasks, including basic accounting tasks, to support small-business or departmental operations.
